attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"neither side has moved a muscle in the interim","reason":"The briefing does not say the armies have been static; it lists the Empire as expanding by force."},{"span":"Kestrel Tribe and Bonecutter Gang numbers have not changed","reason":"The briefing gives no earlier figures to compare against, so it cannot support a claim of no change."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin copies the briefing's section labels as headings, which breaks format and character, and it is padded with flat meta-commentary about having nothing to write.
